title: Midnight is LIVE: what this means for Cardano, privacy, and the next wave of builders
description:
Midnight is live! This episode breaks down what the launch means for the Cardano ecosystem. Peter covers the rational privacy model, the Knight and Dust tokens, and the Compact smart contract language. We also look at the real ecosystem activity taking shape around Midnight: the Mainnet Lite explorer, Midnight Academy, Shield USD’s privacy-focused stablecoin, No C’s wallet and DeFi tooling, and Fluid Tokens’ network integration plans. If you want a practical overview of Midnight’s launch, what’s being built, and where the network is headed next, this is the episode to watch.

⏱️ Chapters:
0:00 Intro
1:10 What Midnight Is
3:10 The Token Model
5:15 Launch Context
7:20 Institutional Operators
9:20 Shield USD
11:15 Nocy Stack
13:10 Fluid Tokens And Ecosystem
15:05 What Comes Next
17:10 Wrap Up

🔑 Key Takeaways:
• Midnight has officially launched as a privacy-focused partner chain in the Cardano ecosystem.
• The network uses a rational privacy model, letting users choose what to reveal.
• It operates on Knight (public governance) and Dust (private fee) tokens.
• Compact, the smart contract language, is designed for TypeScript accessibility.
• Early projects like Shield USD, No C, and Fluid Tokens are already building.
• Selective disclosure acts as a bridge between privacy and regulatory compliance.
